card.name: Verbs and nouns starting list items
card.fires_on: The first word of a list item or a verb-ing phrase in general web text, such as after 'help', 'by', a dash or a comma in a list. Mostly technical or web-site prose, not drug labels.

modes.description: An action verb like fight or reducing right after 'help' or 'by' that begins a phrase.
